title: LED
text: Connect signals attached to LEDs on hardware board, 1 input, {IO logic} sets IO logic indicator; {Hardware board} sets the view selected hardware, {View LEDs location} sets the view LEDs and {Number of LEDs} sets the number of LED ports. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Hardware board
params.values: View selected hardware None (default) | Supported Xilinx ® or Intel ® boards | Custom boards

params.name: IO logic
params.values: IO logic indicator None (default) | Active High | Active Low

params.name: Number of LEDs
params.values: Number of LED ports 1 (default) | list of integers in the range [1, n ]
